title: Good for Basic Needs
text:
Good for Basic Needs. Dish towels are something we all use. Even if you own a dishwasher, there are items that need to be washed by hand and dish towels are good for drying so that you don’t waste paper towels. These dish towels are useful for this basic of household tasks.

Examining these dishtowels reveals that they are very soft, as one would expect for something made entirely from cotton. They are a good size and good for their intended use. They are not as super absorbent as they claim, but that shouldn’t matter for most uses.

I have a variety of dish towels in my house and one thing I have noticed, when comparing these towels to the others, is that these towels are a little bit thinner. That could explain the fact that they are a little less absorbent than they claim. Also, because of the thinness, you need to be careful how you use these towels. I know that some people like to use dish towels to grab hot pans from the oven and for that purpose, these towels are not as good as others. If you want to use them for handling hot pots and pans, just make sure you fold them several times first, to make them thicker and thereby protect your hands.

Dish towels are not the most exciting of merchandise, but they are something found in most every kitchen. These towels are not the best I have ever used, but they seem sufficient to satisfy most needs. Give them a shot if you need the basics covered.
